title: Witboost Catalog Info (Skeleton)
description: Schema for skeleton/catalog-info.yaml files. These are Nunjucks templates rendered during template execution that produce the entity descriptor registered in the Witboost catalog. Witboost assembles the rendered descriptor (flattening all spec.mesh.* fields to root level) and sends it to the tech adapter for validation and provisioning. The 'specific' section is entirely defined by the tech adapter — there is no fixed schema for it.

name.description: Unique entity identifier. In skeletons, typically a Nunjucks expression: ${{ values.identifier }}

description.description: Human-readable description. In skeletons: ${{ values.description | dump }}

annotations.description: Key-value annotations. Common keys: 'backstage.io/techdocs-ref' (usually 'dir:.'), 'witboost.com/end-user-docs-ref', and — on monorepo systems — 'witboost.com/repo-name' (provider-agnostic; holds the repo name only, read by child component templates) plus the optional 'witboost.com/root-directory'.

type.description: System type as defined in Practice Shaper. Default Data Mesh practice: 'dataproduct'. Custom practices may use different names (e.g., 'biproject', 'mlexperiment').
Component type: 'outputport', 'workload', 'storage', or custom types from Practice Shaper.

systemMesh.description: Witboost-specific metadata for system entities. All fields here are flattened to root level in the assembled descriptor sent to the tech adapter.

fullyQualifiedName.description: Full display name including domain and version context.

useCaseTemplateId.description: URN of the use case template that created this system.

infrastructureTemplateId.description: URN of the tech adapter that provisions this system.

componentMesh.description: Witboost-specific metadata for component entities. All fields here are flattened to root level in the assembled descriptor sent to the tech adapter.

kind.description: Component kind: 'outputport', 'workload', 'storage', or custom. Must match spec.type.

fullyQualifiedName.description: Full display name (e.g., 'Finance - CashFlow - version 1 - My Output Port').

infrastructureTemplateId.description: URN of the tech adapter that provisions this component. This determines what fields are expected in the 'specific' section.

useCaseTemplateId.description: URN of the use case template that created this component.

dependsOn.description: List of component URNs this component depends on (same system only).

outputPortType.description: For outputport kind only. Access type: 'SQL', 'Files', 'Streaming'.

consumable.description: Whether this component can be consumed via the marketplace.

shoppable.description: Whether this component appears in the marketplace for subscription.

readsFrom.description: Component/resource URNs this component reads from (can cross system boundaries).

dataContract.description: Data contract definition (schema, SLA, quality rules). Structure depends on the standard used (e.g., BITOL).

dataSharingAgreement.description: Data sharing agreement terms (purpose, billing, security, usage, limitations, lifecycle, confidentiality).

specific.description: Tech-adapter-specific fields. The structure of this section is entirely defined by the tech adapter that provisions this component — there is no fixed schema. Consult the tech adapter's documentation or README to determine the required fields. Example for a Snowflake output port: { viewName, tableName, database, schema }. Example for an S3 storage: { bucketName, region, path }.

source.description: 'Tag' for classification tags, 'Glossary' for business term tags.
